evaluation.selection: All running/waiting mapped non-MLB games in frozen original research ledger and remaining NFL slate at registration. Scheduled mappings with existing pauses are excluded. Only post-launch observations can fill. Anchored models require a newly observed pregame anchor.
evaluation.comparisons: Keep v1.0 and v1.1 unchanged as independent comparisons. Separate REST and WebSocket coverage/results; streaming activation changes transport regime and must be timestamped. Do not pool holding accounts or probes.

evaluation.stop_rules: Respect PAUSE. Halt new account entries at existing $20 loss, $10 entry, 10 contracts, 5 entries, one position and 5-minute cooldown. Stop at slate deadline; missing exits remain unresolved.
evaluation.limitations: Complete observed book checkpoints coalesce intermediate events; no lossless raw-stream claim. Kalshi GETs share a one-per-second ceiling and adaptive backoff; fresh streams need only occasional RTT checks. GET RTT is a proxy, not order latency. No profitability validation.
evaluation.limits_definition: max_pending and max_probe_pending count distinct serviced tickers; opposing sides and holding accounts share the same market-data service.
